version3_error_evidence.failure: Regenerated train candidate/pseudo manifests differ from terminal v6

reason_for_recovery.problem: Terminal v6 compacted away its physical NPZ candidate payloads. Regeneration preserved all candidate structure fields and all 2981 final pseudo-mask hashes but changed NPZ byte hashes and small CUDA-derived floating summaries, so whole-file manifest equality cannot prove causal gallery identity.
reason_for_recovery.forbidden_shortcut: Do not substitute the observed version-3 hashes for terminal-v6 hashes and attribute a resulting v3-minus-v6 delta solely to descriptor geometry.
reason_for_recovery.valid_design: Run a legacy direct-resize control and square-corrected-v3 arm against the exact same newly frozen physical candidate gallery, with descriptor coordinate geometry as the sole scientific difference.

candidate_gallery.train_source: direct immutable mount of geometry-v3 version-3 failed output; fail before heavy work if the physical mount is unavailable
candidate_gallery.validation_source: one fresh prediction-first regeneration with the unchanged terminal-v6 recipe

terminal_v6_semantic_reference_guard.purpose: comparability audit only; causal attribution is supplied by the same-gallery paired control
pseudo_exact_requirements: same image set and order-independent one-to-one join

legacy_control.candidate_mask_geometry: unchanged direct-resize proposal interpreted directly on the RAD-DINO token grid
legacy_control.content_geometry: all token positions treated as real image content, reproducing the pre-correction pooling contract

square_corrected.candidate_mask_geometry: continuous content-box projection into the centered square frame before token pooling
square_corrected.content_geometry: fractional square-frame real-image occupancy excludes padding only from local context

matched_variables: physical train and validation candidate payloads
batch size, optimizer, learning rate and weight decay
prediction evaluator, subgroup definitions and goals
paired_arms.sole_changed_scientific_variable: legacy_direct_resize versus square_corrected_v3 descriptor coordinate geometry
paired_arms.execution: sequential isolated processes; each process requires the same two physical Tesla T4 GPUs and RAD-DINO DataParallel encoder

required_comparisons: legacy control minus promoted flip-TTA baseline
legacy control minus terminal v6 as a descriptive regeneration check
square_corrected minus terminal v6 as descriptive only

forbidden: consumer training before an independently predeclared consumer protocol
using different physical candidate payloads between paired arms
changing seed, optimizer, loss, scorer, epoch budget or WTA output between arms
claiming terminal-v6 comparison as the causal geometry estimate
silently falling back to train candidate regeneration when the version-3 physical mount is unavailable
